method_card.mechanism: One archived 2RE9 or 2O0O mmCIF per invocation. mask is common_ca, common_backbone (all four shared atoms), or ordered_backbone (all four shared atoms, full occupancy and B <= 40 across all chains).
method_card.objective: Describe the effect of atom selection on observed chain-pair geometry.
method_card.estimator: Match label position, residue and atom within model 1/entity 1/A,B,C. Report observed-union coverage, proper Horn least-squares fit, unsigned rotation in degrees and fitted RMSD in angstrom.

manifest.licence: GX release source; coordinate data CC0.
manifest.licence_basis: Original data licence in adapters/scientific/tl1a_geometry/data/LICENSE.cc0 and original geometric metric attribution in LICENSE.chaperone.
manifest.limitations: Comparisons within the asymmetric unit of two deposited structures from one crystallographic study; the method does not estimate population variance or functional properties.
